full_dataset_size: The referenced file is one Inside Airbnb dump: los-angeles/2018-12-06 listings.csv.gz (~44.5k rows x 96 cols, ~30-40 MB uncompressed, ~10 MB gz) plus neighbourhoods.geojson (~1 MB). It is NOT in the repo (0 files, no commit ever contained it) and is off the live IA CDN (403).
description: The job card is wrong on the key point: neshitov/airbnb contains only a Jupyter notebook, a README and three gmplot HTML maps; listings.csv and neighbourhoods.geojson were never committed in any of its 11 commits (Dec 2018). What the repo does preserve is the exact source URL (data.insideairbnb.com/united-states/ca/los-angeles/2018-12-06/data/listings.csv.gz), the row count (44,504 raw) and the full 96-column schema of that vintage via printed notebook output. For ABNB this is at most a pointer for gap #1 (pre-2023 Inside Airbnb dumps): an analyst would need to recover the file from the Wayback Machine or ask Inside Airbnb directly; the notebook itself is a listing-price regression with no forecasting value.
issues: sampled=false: no data file exists in the repo (contents API, recursive tree and all 11 commit trees checked). Live Inside Airbnb CDN URL returns 403 (dump older than the ~1-year retention). Wayback availability/CDX lookups returned HTTP 429 (rate-limited, probably shared with parallel agents) on two attempts; a human should retry web.archive.org for data.insideairbnb.com/united-states/ca/los-angeles/2018-12-06/ later. Repo has no LICENSE (spdx null); README defers to Inside Airbnb's licence (CC BY 4.0 at the time). Recommend downgrading data_kind from stored_dataset to pointer/method.
